answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes by pricing entry: only 20 seats open per epoch, agents bid POA, and a ferrous rule burns every winning bid, so each identity carries a sunk cost. A hollow unstaked bid cannot win: all bids are public, and no bulk buy can hide in a frozen tundra of bids. Forging 100 identities means 100 wins at 50 POA each, burning 5,000 POA, above one epoch reward, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward.
